phase_name: Pre-Operation Transition Final Isolation Boundary Design
phase_japanese_name: 運用移行前の最終隔離境界設計
purpose: Design final isolation boundaries that prevent unintended production transition, side effects, and gate leakage before operation transition authorization

boundaries.boundary_IB1: No production-side write, deploy, or activation path is reachable
boundaries.boundary_IB2: Operation-transition candidate evidence is read-only outside audit append process
boundaries.boundary_IB3: Implementation-start scope and operation-transition scope remain non-escalating
boundaries.boundary_IB4: Any external side-effect interface remains blocked until separate GO gate

rules.rule_IE1: Any boundary violation forces immediate NO_GO reassertion
rules.rule_IE2: Boundary checks are mandatory before any measured authorization attempt
rules.rule_IE3: No implicit inheritance from implementation-start GO to operation-transition GO
rules.rule_IE4: Boundary status must be LOCKED/ENFORCED while operation_transition_go_authorization = NOT_GRANTED
